label: RETRIEVAL QUALITY with REAL embeddings (Ollama) for ingest and query, on the HARD synthetic corpus (near-duplicates across and within tenants, distractors, paraphrases, multi-chunk answers, above-role questions). Chat is the fake LLM. Synthetic and generated: read these numbers as 'this model on this corpus', not as a general claim.
ollamaHostNote: Ollama at localhost, CPU inference unless the host has a GPU; hardware below is the test runner's.
chatProvider: Fake (deterministic; chat is not part of retrieval quality)
hostileRowsNote: 2593 extra rows in 3 hostile tenants (fake hash vectors, never the target of a labelled question) are also in the chunks table, as in the leakage suite; they are invisible to the labelled callers under RLS.
chunkingParameters: fixed-window-chars, whitespace-snap, no trimming; size=500 chars; overlap=100 chars; wordSnapWindow=80 chars

environment.postgres: PostgreSQL 16.15 (Debian 16.15-1.pgdg12+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 12.2.0-14+deb12u1) 12.2.0, 64-bit
environment.databaseLocation: on the same machine as the test runner (CI service container or local)

caveats: Embedding input is the raw chunk / question text; OllamaProvider adds no nomic task prefixes (search_document:/search_query:), so this measures the repo's provider as shipped.

The hard corpus is synthetic and generated from hand-written topic templates with a fixed seed: it is harder than the standard corpus by construction, but it is still not real documents. Do not compare with public benchmarks.

recall@k = |gold in top-k| / |gold| over ALL gold chunks (overlap duplicates of one answer sentence count separately, so this is strict); MRR@k = 1/rank of the first gold chunk in top-k, else 0; complete@k = share of questions whose every answer part has a gold chunk in top-k.
Scored questions are those whose answer the caller may see. Above-role probes have no recall: the check is that the permitted set holds no answer and that no forbidden gold chunk is returned.

Questions are scored per (tenant, role) caller against only the chunks that caller may see; the oracle asserts labels never point at forbidden chunks and that no non-gold chunk of the tenant carries the answer text.
Single run per CI job, no confidence intervals. Per-category buckets are small (12 to 72 distinct questions); treat differences of a few points as noise.
